en: Implement merge(incr_a, incr_b), which takes two iterables incr_a and incr_b whose elements are ordered. merge yields elements from incr_a and incr_b in sorted order, eliminating repetition. You may assume incr_a and incr_b themselves do not contain repeats, and that none of the elements of either are None. You may not assume that the iterables are finite; either may produce an infinite stream of results.
zh: 实现 merge(incr_a, incr_b)，它接收两个元素有序的可迭代对象 incr_a 和 incr_b。merge 按排序顺序产出 incr_a 和 incr_b 中的元素，并消除重复。你可以假设 incr_a 和 incr_b 本身不含重复元素，且两者的元素都不为 None。你不能假设这些可迭代对象是有限的；任何一个都可能产生无限的结果流。

en: Class: The type of an object. The Car class (shown above) describes the characteristics of all Car objects.
zh: 类（Class）：对象的类型。Car 类（如上所示）描述了所有 Car 对象的特征。

en: Object: A single instance of a class. In Python, a new object is created by calling a class.
zh: 对象（Object）：类的一个实例。在 Python 中，通过调用类来创建新对象。

en: Class attribute: A variable that belongs to a class and is accessed via dot notation. The Car class has a max_tires attribute.
zh: 类属性：属于类的变量，通过点号访问。Car 类有一个 max_tires 属性。

en: Instance attribute: A variable that belongs to a particular object. Each Car object has a tires attribute and a color attribute. Like class attributes, instance attributes are accessed via dot notation.
zh: 实例属性：属于某个具体对象的变量。每个 Car 对象都有一个 tires 属性和一个 color 属性。与类属性一样，实例属性也通过点号访问。

en: Method: A function that belongs to an object and is called via dot notation. By convention, the first parameter of a method is self.
zh: 方法：属于对象的函数，通过点号调用。按照约定，方法的第一个参数是 self。

en: __init__: A special function that is called automatically when a new instance of a class is created.
zh: __init__：一种特殊函数，在创建类的新实例时会自动调用。

en: Notice how the drive method takes in self as an argument, but it looks like we didn't pass one in! This is because the dot notation implicitly passes in ferrari as self for us. So in this example, self is bound to the object called ferrari in the global frame.
zh: 注意 drive 方法接收 self 作为参数，但看起来我们并没有传入它！这是因为点号表示法隐式地帮我们把 ferrari 作为 self 传了进去。所以在这个例子里，self 绑定到全局帧中名为 ferrari 的那个对象。

zh: 完成函数 prune_small，它接收一棵树 t 和一个数 n。对于每个分支数超过 n 的节点，只保留标签最小的 n 个分支，并移除（剪去）其余的分支。

en: There's a slight nuance here: in CS 61A, we do runtime analysis with respect to the input. In later classes (such as 61B, CS 170, etc.) runtime analysis is done with respect to the size (i.e. the number of bits) of the input. If this confuses you, don't worry about it too much. Just try to be consistent and tell students that we are considering how a function's runtime is affected when we change the input.
zh: 这里有一个细微的差别：在 CS 61A 中，我们针对输入做运行时间分析。在后续课程（如 61B、CS 170 等）中，运行时间分析是针对输入的规模（即比特数）进行的。如果这让你困惑，不用太在意。只需保持一致，并告诉学生：我们考虑的是输入变化时函数的运行时间会如何变化。

en: Throughout this class, we have mainly focused on correctness — whether a program produces the correct output. However, computer scientists are also interested in creating efficient solutions to problems. One way to quantify efficiency is to determine how a function's runtime changes as its input changes. In this class, we measure a function's runtime by the number of operations it performs.
zh: 在这门课中，我们主要关注正确性——程序是否产生正确的输出。然而，计算机科学家也对构造高效的问题解法感兴趣。量化效率的一种方式是确定函数的运行时间如何随输入变化。在这门课中，我们用函数执行的操作次数来衡量它的运行时间。

en: Example 1: It takes a single multiplication operation to compute square(1), and it takes a single multiplication operation to compute square(100). In general, calling square(n) results in a constant number of operations that does not vary according to n. We say square has a runtime complexity of Θ(1).
zh: 例 1：计算 square(1) 需要一次乘法操作，计算 square(100) 也需要一次乘法操作。一般来说，调用 square(n) 产生的操作次数是常数，不随 n 变化。我们说 square 的运行时间复杂度是 Θ(1)。

en: Example 2: It takes a single multiplication operation to compute factorial(1), and it takes 100 multiplication operations to compute factorial(100). As n increases, the runtime of factorial increases linearly. We say factorial has a runtime complexity of Θ(n).
zh: 例 2：计算 factorial(1) 需要一次乘法操作，而计算 factorial(100) 需要 100 次乘法操作。随着 n 增大，factorial 的运行时间线性增长。我们说 factorial 的运行时间复杂度是 Θ(n)。

en: Evaulating bar(1) results in a single print call, while evalulating bar(100) results in 10,000 print calls. As n increases, the runtime of bar increases quadratically. We say bar has a runtime complexity of Θ(n^2).
zh: 计算 bar(1) 会调用一次 print，而计算 bar(100) 会调用 10,000 次 print。随着 n 增大，bar 的运行时间平方增长。我们说 bar 的运行时间复杂度是 Θ(n^2)。

en: As n increases, the runtime of rec increases exponentially. In particular, the runtime of rec approximately doubles when we increase n by 1. We say rec has a runtime complexity of Θ(2^n).
zh: 随着 n 增大，rec 的运行时间指数增长。特别地，当 n 增加 1 时，rec 的运行时间大约翻倍。我们说 rec 的运行时间复杂度是 Θ(2^n)。

en: We want to create a table that contains the height range (defined as the difference between maximum and minimum height) of all dogs that share a fur type. However, we'll only consider fur types where each dog with that fur type is within 30% of the average height of all dogs with that fur type; we call this the low variance criterion.
zh: 我们想创建一个表，包含共享同一毛发类型的所有狗的身高范围（定义为最大身高与最小身高之差）。不过，我们只考虑这样的毛发类型：具有该毛发类型的每只狗的身高都在该类型所有狗平均身高的 30% 以内；我们把这称为低方差标准。

en: For example, if the average height for short-haired dogs is 10, then in order to be included in our output, all dogs with short hair must have a height of at most 13 and at least 7 (inclusive).
zh: 例如，如果短毛狗的平均身高是 10，那么要被包含在我们的输出中，所有短毛狗的身高必须至多 13、至少 7（含端点）。

en: It evaluates to True because Python's and and or operators short-circuit. That is, they don't necessarily evaluate every operand.

en: If and and or do not short-circuit, they just return the last value; another way to remember this is that and and or always return the last thing they evaluate, whether they short circuit or not. Keep in mind that and and or don't always return booleans when using values other than True and False.
zh: 如果 and 和 or 没有发生短路，它们就只返回最后一个值；另一种记忆方式是：无论是否短路，and 和 or 总是返回它们最后求值的东西。请记住，当使用的值不是 True 和 False 时，and 和 or 并不总是返回布尔值。

en: Write a function that takes in two single-argument functions, f and g, and returns another function that has a single parameter x. The returned function should return True if f(g(x)) is equal to g(f(x)) and False otherwise. You can assume the output of g(x) is a valid input for f and vice versa.
zh: 编写一个函数，接收两个单参数函数 f 和 g，并返回另一个只有一个参数 x 的函数。如果 f(g(x)) 等于 g(f(x))，返回的函数应返回 True，否则返回 False。你可以假设 g(x) 的输出是 f 的有效输入，反之亦然。

en: Hint: Use the remove_first function you just defined, and the built-in min function.
zh: 提示：使用你刚刚定义的 remove_first 函数，以及内置的 min 函数。

en: This is very similar to a homework problem, but recursive. We recommend covering this if you have time, it ties recursion and higher order functions together in an interesting way. Make sure to contrast with self-reference and show why this isn’t that, both in behavior (here a single function call results in a bunch of computation not many function calls) and in implementation (here a call to repeat calls repeat rather than returning a new repeat function).
zh: 这与一道作业题非常相似，只是要求用递归实现。如果有时间，我们建议讲这道题，它以一种有趣的方式把递归和高阶函数结合在了一起。请务必与自引用作对比，说明为什么这不算自引用：既体现在行为上（这里一次函数调用会引发大量计算，而不是大量函数调用），也体现在实现上（这里调用 repeat 会去调用 repeat，而不是返回一个新的 repeat 函数）。

en: Recommended: Complete and use the helper function count_digit to calculate how many times a digit appears in n.
zh: 建议：完成并使用辅助函数 count_digit 来计算某个数字在 n 中出现了多少次。

en: Important: Use recursion; the tests will fail if you use any loops (for, while).
zh: 重要：请使用递归；如果使用任何循环（for、while），测试将无法通过。

en: A data abstraction is a set of functions that compose and decompose compound values. One function called the constructor puts together two or more parts into a whole (such as a rational number; also known as a fraction), and other functions called selectors return parts of that whole (such as the numerator or denominator).
zh: 数据抽象是一组用于组合和分解复合值的函数。其中一个称为构造函数的函数把两个或多个部分组合成一个整体（例如有理数，也叫分数），而另一些称为选择器的函数则返回该整体的各个部分（例如分子或分母）。

en: Use only a single line for the body of the function. (Hint: use a list comprehension.)
zh: 函数体只能使用一行。（提示：使用列表推导式。）

zh: 我们的数据抽象有一个构造函数：

en: We also have the following selectors in order to get the information for each city:
zh: 我们还提供以下选择器，用来获取每个城市的信息：

en: Next, implement closer_city, a function that takes a latitude, longitude, and two cities, and returns the name of the city that is closer to the provided latitude and longitude.
zh: 接下来实现 closer_city，这个函数接收一个纬度、一个经度和两个城市，并返回距离给定经纬度更近的那个城市的名称。

en: Hint: How can you use your distance function to find the distance between the given location and each of the given cities?
zh: 提示：如何用你的 distance 函数求出给定位置到每个给定城市的距离？

en: When writing functions that use a data abstraction, we should use the constructor(s) and selector(s) whenever possible instead of assuming the data abstraction's implementation. Relying on a data abstraction's underlying implementation is known as violating the abstraction barrier.
zh: 在编写使用数据抽象的函数时，我们应尽可能使用构造函数和选择器，而不是假定数据抽象的实现方式。依赖数据抽象的底层实现被称为违反抽象屏障。

en: Challenge: Solve both of these parts with just 1 line of code each.
zh: 挑战：这两部分都只用 1 行代码完成。

en: A full binary tree is a tree where each node has either 2 branches or 0 branches, but never 1 branch.
zh: 满二叉树是指每个节点要么有 2 个分支，要么有 0 个分支，但绝不会只有 1 个分支的树。

en: Hint: A full binary tree can be constructed by connecting two smaller full binary trees to a root node. If the two smaller full binary trees have a and b leaves, the new full binary tree will have a + b leaves. For example, as shown in the first diagram below, a full binary tree with 4 leaves can be constructed by connecting a full binary tree that has three leaves (yellow) with a full binary tree that has one leaf (orange). A full binary tree with 4 leaves can also be constructed by connecting two full binary trees with 2 leaves each (second diagram)
zh: 提示：一棵满二叉树可以通过把两棵较小的满二叉树连接到根节点上来构造。如果这两棵较小的满二叉树分别有 a 个和 b 个叶子，那么新的满二叉树就会有 a + b 个叶子。例如，如下面第一张图所示，一棵有 4 个叶子的满二叉树可以通过把一棵有三个叶子的满二叉树（黄色）与一棵有一个叶子的满二叉树（橙色）连接来构造。有 4 个叶子的满二叉树也可以通过连接两棵各有 2 个叶子的满二叉树来构造（第二张图）

en: Important: No new lists should be created.
zh: 重要：不应创建新列表。

en: Note: If the values passed into before and after are equal, make sure you're not creating an infinitely long list while iterating through it. If you find that your code is taking more than a few seconds to run, the function may be in an infinite loop of inserting new values.
zh: 注意：如果传给 before 和 after 的值相等，请确保在遍历列表时不要创建出无限长的列表。如果你发现代码运行超过几秒钟，这个函数可能陷入了不断插入新值的死循环。

en: Important: Enter StopIteration if a StopIteration exception occurs, Error if you believe a different error occurs, and Iterator if the output is an iterator object.
zh: 重要：如果发生 StopIteration 异常，请输入 StopIteration；如果你认为发生的是其他错误，请输入 Error；如果输出是一个迭代器对象，请输入 Iterator。

en: Important: Python's built-in function map, filter, and zip return iterators, not lists.
zh: 重要：Python 的内置函数 map、filter 和 zip 返回的是迭代器，而不是列表。

en: Important: You should call next on t exactly n times. If you need to iterate through more than n elements, think about how you can optimize your solution.
zh: 重要：你应该对 t 恰好调用 next n 次。如果你需要遍历超过 n 个元素，想一想如何优化你的解法。

en: Given a sequence of unique elements, a permutation of the sequence is a list containing the elements of the sequence in some arbitrary order. For example, [1, 2, 3], [2, 1, 3], [1, 3, 2], and [3, 2, 1] are some of the permutations of the sequence [1, 2, 3].
zh: 给定一个元素互不相同的序列，该序列的一个排列就是按某种任意顺序包含这些元素的一个列表。例如，[1, 2, 3]、[2, 1, 3]、[1, 3, 2] 和 [3, 2, 1] 都是序列 [1, 2, 3] 的排列。

en: Hint: Remember, it's possible to loop over generator objects because generators are iterators!
zh: 提示：记住，生成器对象是可以循环遍历的，因为生成器就是迭代器！

en: Important: Call next on t only the minimum number of times required. If you are receiving a StopIteration exception, your repeated function is calling next too many times.
zh: 重要提示：对 t 调用 next 的次数要尽量少。如果你遇到了 StopIteration 异常，说明你的 repeated 函数调用 next 的次数过多了。

en: Extend the BankAccount class to include a transactions attribute. This attribute should be a list that keeps track of each transaction made on the account. Whenever the deposit or withdraw method is called, a new Transaction instance should be created and added to the list, even if the action is not successful.
zh: 扩展 BankAccount 类，为其添加一个 transactions 属性。该属性应为一个列表，记录账户上发生的每一笔交易。每当调用 deposit 或 withdraw 方法时，都应创建一个新的 Transaction 实例并加入该列表，即使该操作并未成功。

en: Important: Before you start, make sure you read the entire code snippet to understand the relationships between the classes, and pay attention to the parameter type of the methods. Think about what variables you have access to in each method and how can you use them to access the other classes and their methods.
zh: 重要提示：动手之前，请务必通读整段代码，理解各个类之间的关系，并注意方法的参数类型。思考在每个方法中你能访问哪些变量，以及如何利用它们访问其他类及其方法。

zh: 每个 Mint 实例都有一个年份印记。update 方法会把该实例的年份印记设置为 Mint 类的 present_year 类属性。

en: The create method takes a subclass of Coin (not an instance!), then creates and returns an instance of that subclass stamped with the Mint's year (which may be different from Mint.present_year if it has not been updated.)
zh: create 方法接收一个 Coin 的子类（不是实例！），然后创建并返回该类的一个实例，并印上该 Mint 的年份（如果 Mint 尚未更新，这个年份可能不同于 Mint.present_year）。

en: Hint: Keep track of the previous number by setting a new instance attribute inside next. You can create new instance attributes for objects at any point, even outside the __init__ method.
zh: 提示：在 next 中设置一个新的实例属性来记录前一个数。你可以随时为对象创建新的实例属性，即使在 __init__ 方法之外也可以。

en: If you would like some support with visualizing trees, please navigate to {0}, select Start Python Interpreter, and call autodraw().
zh: 如果你想借助可视化工具来理解树结构，请前往 {0}，选择 Start Python Interpreter，然后调用 autodraw()。

en: Hint: Use a helper function to keep track of the depth!
zh: 提示：使用一个辅助函数来记录深度！

en: Hint: Be careful about when you add the new leaves to the tree. We only want to add leaves to the original nodes in the tree, not to the nodes we added.
zh: 提示：注意向树中添加新叶子的时机。我们只想给树中原有的节点添加叶子，而不是给我们新添加的节点添加叶子。

en: If a node is a leaf and there are remaining functions in funcs, all of these remaining functions should be applied in order to the label of the leaf node. If funcs is empty, the tree should remain unmodified.
zh: 如果某个节点是叶子，而 funcs 中还有剩余函数，则应把这些剩余函数按顺序全部作用于该叶子节点的 label。如果 funcs 为空，则树保持不变。

zh:

在 VS Code 中，按 Control + `（Tab 键上方的那个键）可以打开终端。

zh: 提示：使用递归方法可能比迭代方法更容易。

en: Write a function duplicate_link that takes in a linked list s and a value val. It mutates s so that each element equal to val is followed by an additional val (a duplicate copy). It returns None. Be careful not to get into an infinite loop where you keep duplicating the new copies!
zh:
编写函数 duplicate_link，它接收一个链表 s 和一个值 val。
它会修改 s，使每个等于 val 的元素后面都紧跟一个额外的 val（即一份副本）。
它返回 None。注意不要陷入不断复制新副本的死循环！

zh: 注意：要在链表中插入一个链接，需要重新赋值那些 first 为 val 的 Link 实例的 rest 属性。试着画出一个 doctest 的过程来直观理解！

en: Hint: Iterate through the linked list and try keeping track of which Link objects you've already seen.
zh: 提示：遍历该链表，并尝试记录你已经见过哪些 Link 对象。

en: Extra challenge (Optional): Implement has_cycle without keeping track of all Link objects you've already seen. The solution is short (less than 20 lines of code), but requires a clever idea. Try to discover the solution yourself before asking around.
zh: 额外挑战（可选）：在不记录所有已见过的 Link 对象的情况下实现 has_cycle。解法很短（不到 20 行代码），但需要一个巧妙的思路。在向别人求助之前，先试着自己找出答案。

en: Atomic expressions (also called atoms) are expressions without sub-expressions, such as numbers, boolean values, and symbols.
zh: 原子表达式（也称为 atom）是没有子表达式的表达式，例如数字、布尔值和符号。

en: A Scheme symbol is equivalent to a Python name. A symbol evaluates to the value bound to that symbol in the current environment. (They are called symbols rather than names because they include + and other arithmetic symbols.)
zh: Scheme 的符号（symbol）相当于 Python 中的名字。符号求值的结果是当前环境中绑定到该符号的值。（它们之所以被称为符号而不是名字，是因为它们包含 + 以及其他算术符号。）

en: In Scheme, all values except #f (equivalent to False in Python) are true values (unlike Python, which has other false values, such as 0).
zh: 在 Scheme 中，除 #f（相当于 Python 中的 False）之外的所有值都是真值（这与 Python 不同，Python 还有其他假值，例如 0）。

zh: 我们也可以用 quote 形式来创建 list，它会原样构造所给出的那个 list。与 list 过程不同，' 的参数不会被求值。

en: map — Transforms each element, keeping the same number of elements. It's like you walk down the list and replace each item with (fn item).
zh: map — 转换每个元素，元素个数保持不变。就像你沿着 list 往下走，把每一项替换成 (fn item)。

en: filter — Keeps or drops each element, but never changes. Tests a yes/no predicate, if yes it stays as it is and if no it is dropped.
zh: filter — 保留或丢弃每个元素，但从不改变元素。它测试一个“是/否”谓词：是则原样保留，否则丢弃。

en: reduce — Collapses the whole list down to a single value (with a left to right combining procedure)
zh: reduce — 把整个 list 折叠成单个值（使用一个从左到右的合并过程）

zh:
